request.text: Check whether it will rain in Shanghai at 4 p.m. today, and at the same time set a 3:30 p.m. reminder for me to take reusable bags to the grocery store.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up whether rain is expected in Shanghai at 4 p.m. today.
Create a reminder for 3:30 p.m. today to take reusable bags to the grocery store, independently and concurrently with the weather lookup.

semantic_facts: The plan should preserve two independently traceable executions: a Shanghai weather lookup for 4 p.m. today and a 3:30 p.m. reminder to take reusable bags.
The two executions may proceed concurrently; neither should be dropped or made dependent on the other's result.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that rain is or is not expected without weather evidence.
The assistant claims the reminder was created without trusted completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: One of two concurrent responsibilities is silently discarded or merged into the other.
A stateful effect or external information result is reported as complete without capability evidence.
